snippet.title: False Hero - Official Playtest Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos.

Wishlist and join the playtest on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538870/False_Hero/?l=english

Join the Discord for more updates:
https://discord.gg/yHUdDcYJZ6
